bible.title: Tolls and Theatricals
bible.kernel: A bridge tollkeeper hires the company to trace missing bridge takings, leading to a caught performer who may join.

cast.name: Bruiant Thatcher
cast.who: A bridge tollkeeper who runs the crossing west of the fort and fears his takings have been stolen.
cast.want: to recover the bridge's missing tolls and stop their diversion

cast.name: Mahei-Tei Salt-born
cast.who: A saltborn gnome carter who moves convoys through the Western Forests and signs his drays with a salt-seal.
cast.want: to keep the earnings his convoys bring and protect his routes

cast.name: Nareb Duskbough
cast.who: An elven entertainer from the Western Forests who performs at bridgefolk camps and draws small crowds.
cast.want: to join the company as a marcher and entertainer

bible.situation: Bruiant Thatcher believes coins taken at his bridge are being siphoned off. He hires the company to find where the tolls go and to stop the diversion.
bible.goal: to recover the bridge's missing tolls and stop their diversion
arc: Go to Bruiant Thatcher's bridge and trace the path missing toll tokens take from the tollhouse → yields: a stamped iron toll token bearing a salt-seal tied to Mahei-Tei Salt-born

Carry the salt-seal token into Mahei-Tei Salt-born's Gravelwell staging lot and press his draymen for who uses that seal → yields: a scrubbed entertainer's scarf embroidered with Nareb Duskbough's mark and a torn route tag for Rookcart Hollow
Shadow the route to Rookcart Hollow using the torn tag and watch the convoy at a night halt to find a way inside → yields: an iron cage key taken from a sleeping drayman's belt

Return with the key and ambush Mahei-Tei Salt-born's convoy back at Bruiant Thatcher's bridge, force him to surrender the diverted satchel of toll coins and free the captive. Hand the satchel to Bruiant and win Nareb's choice to join the company
bible.twist: The diverted tolls do not merely vanish; they pay for a trafficking trade that buys entertainers and forest folk for a cruel private buyers' circuit.
tensions: Mahei-Tei will fight or ransom his cargo to keep the diverted earnings
Bruiant will demand coin or proof, not a rescued person, forcing a hard accounting choice
Forest wardens hate public brawls on grove roads and may break up an ambush
openDirections: If the ring keeps running, other crossings will be bribed and the fort will see more hired raids to maintain the trade.
bible.stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the bridge's winter grain fund will be spent elsewhere and the bridgefolk's communal stores will be sold off.
bible.arrival: crossed the river to get here · had rehearsed it

shipped.title: Trace the missing toll tokens
shipped.situation: A tollkeeper, Bruiant Thatcher, crossed the river and had rehearsed his words when he drew up to the fort. He looks at the door before answering and says the bridge's toll tokens have been taken from the tollhouse. If you fail, the bridge's winter grain fund will be spent elsewhere and the bridgefolk's communal stores will be sold off. He wants you to trace the path the missing tokens take from his tollhouse, the fee fixed and whatever else shakes loose the company keeps. A carter aims to keep his convoys' earnings and to protect his routes. He names Rookcart Hollow as a thin fold in the woods where convoys take night halts, and wonders if his tokens vanish there.
shipped.job: Go to Bruiant Thatcher's bridge and trace the path missing toll tokens take from the tollhouse
